tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up the Peggle Nights randomizer connected to an Archipelago Multiworld
tutorials.text:
# Peggle Nights Randomizer Setup Guide

## Requirements
- Windows OS (Hard required. Client is using memory reading / writing / allocation through Windows APIs)
- Peggle Nights installed through Steam
  - Only the English version is supported. Other languages use different executables. 
  - The language can be changed in Properties -> General on Steam
- Archipelago 0.6.7+

**Hashes of expected PeggleNights.exe**

```
Name: PeggleNights.exe
Size: 5278776 bytes (5155 KiB)
CRC32: AA0A91B1
CRC64: 7CA74E22A9D8FDA1
SHA256: 98bb17b774eaf6eeb07df5979e1f008846722c73dd31c0a6e2eede6933c38352
SHA1: e4edd172fcca6fd091c1c06d24aee571c127eeac
BLAKE2sp: 4f3d9397bc243eb2c03943c64a2e4ec21c99c7fd797b27fa85bec95f083dec23
```

## Game Setup Instructions
No manual mod installation or other configuration is required to play Peggle Nights with Archipelago. The client included with the APWorld does all the work by attaching to the game process and monitoring and manipulating the game state in real-time.

**IMPORTANT**

Once the Archipelago client is connected, hooks and patches will be set up in the game's memory. _**If the client is ever closed, Peggle Nights will NEED to be restarted before connecting another client**_ for everything to function as expected. If you don't restart the game, the previous hooks and patches will remain installed with no way for the new client to detect and use them.

**Notes** 
- You don't need to have completed Adventure Mode to play. The client will be able to unlock the Quick Play levels as needed regardless of Adventure progress.
- Fever Meter Multiplier location checks will send when you hit the next peg after reaching the multiplier in the fever meter

## Joining a Multiworld Game
- Launch Peggle Nights and either sit on the splash screen or advance to the main menu
- Open the Archipelago Launcher. Find and click _Peggle Nights Client_
- Using the _Peggle Nights Client_:
  - Enter the room's hostname and port number (e.g. archipelago.gg:54321) in the top box and click Connect
  - Input your player name at the bottom when prompted and press Enter
  - You should now be connected to the Archipelago room
  - After a few seconds, you should see a message in the client that says `Peggle Nights process found!`
  - You are now ready to play Peggle Nights with Archipelago. Make sure to check out the `Peggle Nights` tab in the client

## Continuing a Multiworld Game
- Perform the same steps as above

notes.text:
This is a major feature release that also includes improvements and tweaks. 
It brings Peggle Nights to parity with the features of Peggle Deluxe 2.2.0.

**This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.**

- **Feature:** In-Game Level Locking
- **Feature:** In-Game Master Locking
- **Feature:** Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items have been completely replaced by level-specific Progressive Orange Pegs items, leading to more interesting and layered progression, as well as requiring a bit more skill for the early game phase
- **Feature:** Purple Pegs are now unlockable by level
- **Feature:** Each Peggle Master now has their own set of Progressive Green Pegs items, creating opportunities for suboptimal masters to now be optimal to play under certain circumstances
- **Feature:** Added in / out of logic location counts under each level image in the Levels section of the custom client tab. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed
- **Feature:** The section of the custom client tab showing information about the current level now lists what locations are accessible in / out of logic. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed
- **Improvement:** To avoid the confusion that was present in 1.x.x around getting fever mode and no completion check, Level Clear location checks will now unlock after any fever mode completes. They will require half your starting ball items logically, but nothing prevents them from triggering
- **Improvement:** To preserve the relevance of the 4th Progressive Orange Pegs item now that level completions have moved to the early-mid game, new Fever Meter Full location checks have been added
- **Improvement:** Starting level count increased from 1 to 3
- **Improvement:** Starting ball count is now set through a custom code patch instead of directly setting the memory value, meaning that the Ball-O-Tron will now always display the correct amount of balls
- **Improvement:** Getting the required quantity of Shadow Pegs is now all that's needed to access and clear the final level. No extra items to chase
- **Improvement:** Added 3 extra copies of Progressive Starting Ball Increase and 1 extra copy of each Progressive Orange Pegs variant to allow for less restrictive progression and reaching the cap faster
- **Improvement:** Slightly reworked logic, mainly around fever meter multipliers
- **Improvement:** Custom client tab has been updated to reflect the new features
- **Tweak:** Permanent Fever Meter Bonus useful items have been removed

_No new YAML options. Minimum level count is now 15 to make room for all the new items. You will need to remove Permanent Fever Meter Bonus from your useful item weights for existing YAMLs to be valid_

The implementation now has proper [documentation](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/en_Peggle_Nights.md) and a [setup guide](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/setup_en.md)
